faqAuthQ: Do I need permission to scan?
faqAuthA: Only hosts and apps you own or are authorized to test. Unauthorized scanning is not allowed.
faqPentestA: No. Automated outside-in posture (DAST-class baseline), not business logic or a week-long engagement. Keep an annual pentest if the contract requires it.
faqDataA: Results live in your workspace. See the privacy policy. Do not upload secrets you cannot store.
faqGuardQ: Guard vs SIEM vs Host Protect?
faqGuardA: Guard: inventory + critical alerts. SIEM: log search + Cases tickets, ops-flagged, off by default. Host Protect: on-box malware via a helper — without it we wait; we do not invent findings.
faqAgentA: No. One wazuh-agent per VM. Host Protect is a helper script on the same machine, not a second enroll daemon.
